system.description:
Touch; casting takes 1 minute.

  • One willing dead creature, dead no longer than 1 day per level, whose body is intact (head and torso present).
  • It returns with 1 HP, 4 levels of Exhaustion, no spells prepared, and permanently loses 1 Constitution (minimum 3).
  • This loss is not drain: only Wish or Miracle can restore it.
  • Fails if the creature died of old age, is undead, or was destroyed by Disintegrate. No save.
  • Material: diamond dust worth 500 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Necromancer
